name: campus-rag-index-publisher
description: Unified immutable Campus Docs and Notices Qdrant serving index publisher.

scripts.build: node --input-type=module -e "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; rmSync('dist', { force: true, recursive: true })" && esbuild ./src/cli.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node24 --outfile=dist/cli.js --external:@aws-sdk/client-s3 --external:pg && node --input-type=module -e "import('./dist/cli.js')"
